title: Existence of the normalized derived scalar tensor comparison
statement: The signed total comparison is descended through K-flat representatives and derived localization. The resulting isomorphism satisfies the required normalization on every flat K-flat pair, yielding exactly the displayed existential statement.

source.place: Tags 06YY and 07A4, derived scalar/tensor descent and normalization

proof.text: The scalar-extension counit is invertible on a flat-term K-flat complex: convert its K-flat predicate to the independent-coefficient predicate and apply the recorded universal counit computation.

Apply changeOfRings_isKFlat_of_flat_terms_independentCoefficients to the actual pbcExtend functor, using its recorded object and morphism equations. Transport termwise flatness along siteSheafTensorRightIso. The scalar extension of every resolving complex is again resolving.
The total of two resolving complexes is resolving by kFlat_total_tensor_model. In particular, the scalar counit on their total is invertible.

Package scalarTensorTotal and its proved invertibility as a natural isomorphism. Its naturality is the signed-total naturality theorem applied to scalarOrdinaryTensor_naturality. Use the cochain natural transformation of universal scalar counits and faithful restriction to flat representatives, as in the existing pro-etale descent-data proof.

Apply tensorComparisonDescent to the inverse total comparison, the two given tensor representative identifications, and the counit isomorphisms. Its normalization equation is definitionally the displayed scalar comparison equation; choose the preserved flat representative proofs as the required witnesses.
